description.summary: touch input from a client, for remote desktops

protocol.description:
A remote-desktop service replays a remote user's touches on the local session: the xdg-desktop-portal RemoteDesktop NotifyTouch* calls and an EIS client's ei_touchscreen. wlr-virtual-pointer and virtual-keyboard-unstable-v1 cover the pointer and the keyboard; no protocol covers touch.
A virtual touch device places its touch points in the compositor's output layout the way wlr-virtual-pointer's motion_absolute places the pointer: a position is x/x_extent and y/y_extent of the bounding box of every output. The compositor delivers the points as if a touchscreen spanning the layout produced them.

interface.name: lys_virtual_touch_manager_v1
interface.description: A privileged global: compositors hide it from sandboxed clients.

request.name: create_virtual_touch
request.description: Creates a touch device on the seat.

interface.name: lys_virtual_touch_v1

description.summary: a virtual touchscreen spanning the output layout

interface.description: Touch points of one device. Each down, motion, up and cancel takes effect at the next frame, as wl_touch groups them. The device's points are its own: their ids never collide with another device's.

entry.name: invalid_id
entry.summary: a down with an id already down, or one at or above 65536

entry.name: invalid_extent
entry.summary: an extent of 0, or a position past its extent

request.name: down
request.description: A new touch point id goes down at the position. The id must not be down already on this device.

request.name: motion
request.description: A point that is down moves to the position. A point not down is ignored: it may have been cancelled by the compositor.

request.name: up
request.description: A point that is down lifts. A point not down is ignored.

request.name: cancel

description.summary: every touch point of the device is cancelled

request.description: The device's points end without an up: what they were doing is abandoned, as wl_touch.cancel has it.

request.name: frame

description.summary: the end of a set of changes

request.description: The downs, motions, ups and cancels since the last frame take effect together.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The device's points that are still down are cancelled.
